text: Will Silver Blaze run in the Wessex Cup? — yes: he will be found fit and run on Tuesday
id: q.horse_runs=yes: he will be found fit and run on Tuesday
why: The question is fair, since the Colonel raises withdrawing the horse and Holmes says to let the name stand. But the answer given, that Silver Blaze will be found fit and run on Tuesday, is not stated or implied anywhere in the story so far. The horse is still missing, and the story offers no reason to expect he will be found in time.
